problem: Git-linked Netlify production deploys could stall while the MCP proxy fallback depended on an expiring GitHub Actions secret.
root_cause: Production delivery had only two paths: Git-linked auto-deploy and a temporary MCP proxy secret. When Git delivery stalled and the proxy credential expired, exact-source promotion had no durable CI transport.
prevention: Production Source Snapshot must prefer an existing NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN for authenticated Netlify CLI deployment when Git-linked delivery misses the expected SHA.
If NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN is absent, fall back to the authorized MCP proxy transport.
Never print token or proxy values in logs.
After either transport, exact release.json SHA, production context and pricing/i18n browser proof remain mandatory before LIVE_BEWEZEN.

evidence.transport_gap: git trigger stalled; MCP proxy secret previously expired
